triggerReasons.message: High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: M1 is accepted only if node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m1-freeze-check.mjs passes locally, required cells ③/⑥/② are encoded with ④ optional, provider execution and outcome records remain absent, and Lattice closure does not claim Phase 1 data or readiness.

note: Acceptance is bound to all five checklist items because M1 only succeeds when the lock artifacts, launch gate, checker, and Lattice closure together prove provider-free readiness boundaries.
